mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_session_import (import_id, share_id, recipient_scope_key, tenant_id, user_id, source_sha256, new_session_id, status) VALUES (#{importId}, #{shareId}, #{recipientScopeKey}, #{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{sourceSha256}, #{newSessionId}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, import_id, share_id, recipient_scope_key, tenant_id, user_id, source_sha256, new_session_id, status, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM chat_session_import WHERE share_id=#{shareId} AND recipient_scope_key=#{recipientScopeKey} AND deleted=0 LIMIT 1
